patch.inserted: Record the buyer's own words exactly when they differ from the listed options ("peti" stays "peti", "all sizes" stays "all sizes", "pharmacy college" stays as said). Never replace a value with the closest option. If it is unclear which option the buyer means, repeat their words back once and ask.
before: Accept listed options or meaningful custom values relevant to the field. Preserve custom values without forcing them into listed options.
after: Update @specifications with each field-value pair, preserving other fields. Capture answers to future fields immediately and skip those questions later.
Record explicit lack of preference as ANY and close the field.

scripts.title: Pharmacy college use recorded as hospital
scripts.persona: A buyer sourcing heavy-duty plastic bags for a pharmacy college wants to specify the exact use case.
lines: Bhaiya, hume 9x13 inch ke bags chahiye pharmacy college ke liye.
Yeh medical supplies pack karne ke kaam aayenge.
Thode zyada strong chahiye, zyada tear nahi hone chahiye.
Aapke paas koi aur size hai kya?
Material mein virgin hi theek rahega.
Aur delivery 3 din mein kar dena.
scripts.expect: The bot should record 'pharmacy college' exactly as the buyer said without swapping it to 'hospital use'.

scripts.title: Chote dhakkan wali recorded as 9x13 inch
scripts.persona: A buyer looking for small-cap plastic bags to store small hardware items wants a smaller size.
lines: Bhai, chote dhakkan wali bag chahiye, 9x13 inch se thoda chota.
Chote screws aur nails store karne hain.
Delivery kal tak ho jaye toh accha hai.
Rate thoda kam rakhna, regular order hai.
scripts.expect: The bot should record 'chote dhakkan wali' exactly and not replace it with '8x13 inch' or any listed option.

scripts.title: All sizes recorded as 8x10 inch
scripts.persona: A buyer who needs plastic bags in all available sizes for a general store wants to order multiple sizes at once.
lines: Bhaiya, mujhe dono size chahiye, 8x10 inch aur 9x13 inch.
Sabhi sizes ek saath bhej do.
Quantity 5 peti har ek size ki.
scripts.expect: The bot should record 'all sizes' or '8x10 inch aur 9x13 inch' exactly instead of recording only '8x10 inch'.

scripts.title: 72 pieces recorded as 72 sqft
scripts.persona: A buyer ordering small plastic bags for retail packaging wants to specify 72 pieces.
lines: Ek piece 10 rupaye ka hai toh rate batao.
Rate mein thoda discount de dena.
scripts.expect: The bot should record '72 pieces' exactly and not swap the unit to 'sqft'.

scripts.title: Quantity and unit recorded when not given
scripts.persona: A buyer asking about plastic bag specifications wants to know the options and pricing without committing to a quantity.
lines: Bhai, 9x13 inch ke virgin bags hain kya?
Rate kitna padega ek piece ka?
Thoda sample bhej do check karne ke liye.
scripts.expect: The bot should leave quantity and unit blank since the buyer never gave any quantity or unit.

scripts.title: Cooperative buyer asks for 8x10 inch virgin bags
scripts.persona: A cooperative buyer who wants to order 8x10 inch virgin material plastic bags in a specific quantity.
scripts.expect: The bot should record the exact size, material, and quantity without any substitution or hallucination.
